FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Have another question? You are welcome to get in touch.

Contact us ↗
Can I get support in Japanese?

Yes, you are welcome to ask for support in Japanese.

Can you also help in German or English?

Yes, enquiries in German and English are also welcome.

Can you visit my home?

Tell us your location and needs, and we can discuss whether a visit is possible.

Can I get help online?

Depending on the issue, online support may be an option to discuss.

Can you help me choose a PC?

We can discuss device choices based on your needs and setup after purchase.

Can you advise me about internet contracts?

You can ask about providers, contracts and help with enquiries in German.

How are fees decided?

After clarifying the scope and time involved, we provide an individual estimate before work starts.

Do you support areas outside Düsseldorf?

Enquiries from nearby areas are welcome. Contact us to discuss the options.
